svg.title: TX card cage side and front
svg.text: SIDE (section): back wall and pole left, lid right
glands, right wall (2 x 4): 7 PG-7, 1 PG-9
body / lid seam (Yb 48): lid tray beyond
TX card cage r3 in the #905 box (hanging, long side up), to scale 3.2 px/mm; box inside 121 x 169 x 72 mm [TBD-MEASURE]
Blue: printed cage. Red slabs: cards. Tan: backplane. Dashed: plug keep-outs. Dark squares in the side view: the glands in the right wall.
Grey: the box (corner posts, floor posts A-C, D tabs). The charger (outline [TBD-MEASURE]) stands parallel to the floor in front of the backplane, the pack in front of it, both below the cards.
